title: Part II · Section 02
subtitle: Future-tense Q
introEn: Listen to each question and choose the best response (Future-tense Q).

items.prompt: Who's not going to the office Christmas party next Friday?

choices.A: Yes, all day Saturday and Sunday.
choices.B: Yes, I think I'd like that very much.
choices.C: I heard it was going to rain.

items.prompt: What's the weather supposed to be like this weekend?
What are you doing after you finish work?

choices.A: Yes, the interview went very well.
choices.C: They said they would call me on Friday.

items.prompt: When will you find out if you got the job?

choices.A: The company moved here over 10 years ago.
choices.B: My wife and I both work for the company.
choices.C: My wife and I have not discussed it yet.

items.prompt: What are you going to do if the company decides to move?
Where are you going to leave your dog when you go on vacation?
